about: Package 7's acceptance: every scenario whose subject is the Workflows panel (factory and user workflows, revisions, the save row in both modes, rename, update, delete, revert, export and import, Save as, the modified rows, the row menu and the list's keys), the drafts, or what the page keeps in storage (stored records read one by one, kept aside, merged with another tab, the Saved read-out). The concept's own scenarios where they reach what the rebuild has; scenarios/33-workflows.mjs states the concept's claims where its scenarios reach for what the rebuild does differently (setVal on a module off the desk, the prompt card's #prompt, the concept's desk key), nine of its fourteen holding on the concept page too. `waiting` names the package whose part a scenario needs; `excluded` says why each other scenario that looks like this package's is left out.

scenarios.why: A workflow row loads its modules and pedals (click, Enter, Space), Open in its tier, the toast's Undo.
The chevron shows revisions; a revision loads its workflow, engine and settings; its details; Enter; a changed one gets Revert and Save as; export as JSON.

The save row: a revision of the open workflow, no name refused beside the field, Enter, stored, details, Replace with Undo, New workflow, a factory name refused, the follow-up action, Escape, the toggle.
A changed desk marks its workflow; Update with Undo; Revert; Save as… on a factory row.
F-02: one name rule for rename, save and import; a rename never files two workflows under one key, and can be undone; any workflow name works, even __proto__.
F-03: after a row action focus is on that row (or its menu button).
A revision file imports cleaned, into its workflow, with what was left out counted; again replaces it with Undo; broken JSON and a non-revision refused.

Stored lists that are no lists start empty, and nothing breaks. Its desk seed (hs3-desk) means nothing here (deviation 5): the toast its first check reads is the drafts' (also unreadable); the desk's own is 33-workflows/unreadable-desk-kept-aside.
C-03: a revision's Revert puts back its settings and leaves the desk as arranged; both rows read modified; the toast with Undo.
C-02: Replace keeps the casing and stores the new settings; Undo brings the old back, Redo replaces again; C-22: a name typed and abandoned does not come back.
C-08: the page boots past bad records, keeps what can be repaired, checks revisions one by one, says once what it skipped; Drafts opens with the readable one.
F-16: a key that is not JSON is copied aside before anything overwrites it; saving still works, the copy stays.
C-09: a workflow saved in another tab appears here; a save here keeps it; a delete there reaches here and keeps ours.
F-10: names compare normalised, so two spaces offer Replace.
F-16: a record that can't be read is skipped and the whole stored value is copied aside first, and stays in the copy after the next save.
F-31: a 28-character name shown whole; F-23: a revision saved under a factory workflow marked yours; the empty Yours group says where they are.
Pending (F-17) in the concept, right here: a workflow renamed in another tab stays open under its new name.
Pending (F-36) in the concept, right here: F2 renames a row of yours, Delete arms its Delete, a letter moves to the next row starting with it.
The workflow tree's Right key: the first opens it and stays, the second enters its first revision.

Pending (S-17) in the concept, right here: inside the Drafts popover, Tab from the name goes to Save draft, with a toast up. Package 6's toast, when it claims Tab (deviation 9), must keep this passing.

03-workflows/rename-delete-menu with the Sampler on Alpha's desk: the row menu, rename (Enter, a name in use refused beside the field, Escape, blur), the two-step delete with Undo, Update on a revision with Undo. Holds on the concept too.
09-undo-storage/row-heights-hold with the Sampler on Mine's desk: C-01, one height per state through hover and focus. Holds on the concept too.

09-undo-storage/undo-leaves-later-work without the prompt card: C-07, the opening undone from its toast reverses only itself; Redo by its toast's words, the Redo button, Ctrl+Shift+Z. Holds on the concept too.

07-overlays-keys/drafts without the prompt card: the popover above the go bar, save, toggle, named on another engine, one row height, Save resting, Load on another engine with Undo, delete with Undo and focus kept (C-25), thirty kept, Escape.
17-undo-net/a-refused-draft-is-not-called-saved without the prompt card: F-15.
17-undo-net/saved-says-only-what-was-saved with settings for the typing: F-15, Not saved while the desk's writes are refused, said once, Saved again after a write succeeds. Holds on the concept too.
21-chrome-round5/unreadable-desk-kept-aside under the page's own desk key: F-16, copied aside, said, downloaded, kept past the next autosave.
08-persistence-cables/old-shape-ignored under the page's own desk key: a desk of a shape the page cannot read starts clean, kept aside, said.
F-27 (07-overlays-keys/notes-logs-escape's save-row checks): Escape outside the row leaves it, inside closes it; C-22, it opens empty. Holds on the concept too.
C-24: a revision exported from the row menu imports back under its workflow (made again from the file), said, undone. Holds on the concept too.
The open workflow and the revisions shown are kept over a reload.
08-persistence-cables/restore-cleans's workflow check: an open workflow that is not here reads as Start fresh.
C-09: a save reads storage first and merges, so another tab's write is kept before its storage event arrives.
The Drafts list, as the concept states it.

scenarios.why: F-15 for a draft, as the concept states it.

waiting.because: It types into #prompt first; 33-workflows/a-refused-draft-is-not-called-saved checks the same until package 4 draws it.

scenarios.why: C-07, as the concept states it.

waiting.because: It types into #prompt after the opening and checks the description; 33-workflows/opening-undone-leaves-later-work checks the same with setVal until package 4 draws it.

scenarios.why: E-03: a revision holds the Repetition guard, a change to it marks the revision, Revert puts it back (15-other-engines/revision-holds-the-guard with Revision chosen in the save row). Holds on the concept too.
S-09: a revision without adapters unloads them, said, with Undo.
C-31: the Import button's tip is the page's own.

excluded.why: Its scene puts Repetition and the Sampler on the desk after opening Start fresh, then presses Save expecting a revision. The concept's modified flag is set only by a person's change, so there Save opens as a revision; here modified is what Revert would put back (deviation P7-4), Start fresh reads modified, and Save opens as a new workflow (the concept's own rule for a changed desk), so it saves a workflow and no revision. The revision does hold the guard (tools/test-workflows.ts); 33-workflows/revision-holds-the-guard is the same scenario with Revision chosen, and passes on both pages.

Its last part sets samp.steps with setVal while Gamma's desk has no Sampler; the rebuild changes a value only through a control on the desk (the slice's setVal), so it cannot pass as written. The same scenario with the Sampler on the desk is 33-workflows/rename-delete-menu.
The same off-desk setVal (Mine has no Sampler), so the revision is never modified; 33-workflows/row-heights-hold puts the Sampler on Mine's desk.

It seeds the concept's own earlier keys (hs3-layouts, hs3-presets, hs3-profiles), which only an earlier concept wrote; the rebuild reads the concept's saved shape (version 0) under the concept's list key, not its history.

It seeds the concept's desk key; the desk is kept under the page's own key in the page's shape (deviation 5), and the desk store reads it before the test layer can translate a seed. 33-workflows/unreadable-desk-kept-aside seeds the page's key.
The same, for a desk of an older shape: 33-workflows/old-shape-kept-aside.

A concept desk record seeded under the concept's key, cleaned field by field: the desk's restore is the slice's, and its shape the page's own; its workflow check (an unknown workflow reads as Start fresh) is 33-workflows/an-unknown-open-workflow-reads-as-start-fresh.
Mostly other packages' state (the repaint source, slots, seed, timbre, songs); the open workflow and the revisions shown are kept under hotstep.create.workflow.
Write it for me and the description: the prompt package's (4).
Undo under the popover and the notes: package 8's layers (it opens a workflow first only to have something to undo).
The notes and the engine log (package 8); its save-row checks (F-27) are 33-workflows/escape-in-the-save-row.
Pending (F-07): Ctrl+Enter generates from a workflow row (the rows already take a plain Enter only); generation and the prompt are packages 6 and 4.
The go bar's layout with a song playing: package 6.
